from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo


BJ = ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")


def now_utc() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def delivery_date(value: datetime) -> date:
    if value.tzinfo is None:
        value = value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return value.astimezone(BJ).date()


REVISION = "r1"
EXPECTED_BUILD = "v1.4-20260928-r1-coreput3x-open-fix7-nocall-repeatroll-iciv30-qdelta05"
EXPECTED_DELIVERY_REVISION = "20260928-v14-coreput3x-open-fix7-nocall-repeatroll-iciv30-qdelta05"
FIX8_BUILD = "v1.4-20260929-r1-ordinaryput-open-fix8"
FIX8_DELIVERY_REVISION = "20260929-v14-ordinary-put-open-fix8"
FIX9_BUILD = "v1.4-20260929-r1-ordinaryput-open-ic-seller-mom120-fix9"
FIX9_DELIVERY_REVISION = "20260929-v14-ordinary-put-open-ic-seller-mom120-fix9"
FIX10_BUILD = "v1.4-20261008-r1-fear-grid25-50-fix10"
FIX10_DELIVERY_REVISION = "20261008-v14-fear-grid25-50-fix10"
FIX11_BUILD = "v1.4-20261008-r1-ic-csi500-abs40-fix11"
FIX11_DELIVERY_REVISION = "20261008-v14-ic-csi500-abs40-fix11"
FIX6_BUILD = "v1.4-20260926-r1-coreput3x-fixedshort95-fix6-nocall-repeatroll-iciv30-qdelta05"
FIX6_DELIVERY_REVISION = "20260926-v14-coreput3x-fixedshort95-fix6-nocall-repeatroll-iciv30-qdelta05"
LEGACY_BUILD = "v1.4-20260924-r1-coreput3x-fixedshort95-fix4-integrated-iciv30-qdelta05"
LEGACY_DELIVERY_REVISION = "20260924-v14-coreput3x-fixedshort95-fix4-integrated-iciv30-qdelta05"
REPEAT_ROLL_EFFECTIVE_DATE = date(2026, 9, 26)
PROFIT_OPEN_EFFECTIVE_DATE = date(2026, 9, 28)
ORDINARY_PUT_OPEN_EFFECTIVE_DATE = date(2026, 9, 29)
FEAR_GRID_EFFECTIVE_DATE = date(2026, 10, 8)
IC_CSI500_EFFECTIVE_DATE = date(2026, 10, 8)
IDENTITY_TAG = hashlib.sha256(
    f"{EXPECTED_BUILD}\n{EXPECTED_DELIVERY_REVISION}".encode("utf-8")
).hexdigest()[:12]
LEGACY_IDENTITY_TAG = hashlib.sha256(
    f"{LEGACY_BUILD}\n{LEGACY_DELIVERY_REVISION}".encode("utf-8")
).hexdigest()[:12]
FIX6_IDENTITY_TAG = hashlib.sha256(
    f"{FIX6_BUILD}\n{FIX6_DELIVERY_REVISION}".encode("utf-8")
).hexdigest()[:12]
FIX8_IDENTITY_TAG = hashlib.sha256(
    f"{FIX8_BUILD}\n{FIX8_DELIVERY_REVISION}".encode("utf-8")
).hexdigest()[:12]
FIX9_IDENTITY_TAG = hashlib.sha256(
    f"{FIX9_BUILD}\n{FIX9_DELIVERY_REVISION}".encode("utf-8")
).hexdigest()[:12]
FIX10_IDENTITY_TAG = hashlib.sha256(
    f"{FIX10_BUILD}\n{FIX10_DELIVERY_REVISION}".encode("utf-8")
).hexdigest()[:12]
FIX11_IDENTITY_TAG = hashlib.sha256(
    f"{FIX11_BUILD}\n{FIX11_DELIVERY_REVISION}".encode("utf-8")
).hexdigest()[:12]


def expected_identity_for_day(value: date) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if value >= IC_CSI500_EFFECTIVE_DATE:
        return FIX11_BUILD, FIX11_DELIVERY_REVISION
    if value >= FEAR_GRID_EFFECTIVE_DATE:
        return FIX10_BUILD, FIX10_DELIVERY_REVISION
    if value >= ORDINARY_PUT_OPEN_EFFECTIVE_DATE:
        return FIX9_BUILD, FIX9_DELIVERY_REVISION
    if value >= PROFIT_OPEN_EFFECTIVE_DATE:
        return EXPECTED_BUILD, EXPECTED_DELIVERY_REVISION
    if value >= REPEAT_ROLL_EFFECTIVE_DATE:
        return FIX6_BUILD, FIX6_DELIVERY_REVISION
    return LEGACY_BUILD, LEGACY_DELIVERY_REVISION


def marker_prefix(value: date, publication_mode: str) -> str:
    mode = publication_mode.strip().lower()
    if mode not in {"realtime", "close_confirmed"}:
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported publication mode: {publication_mode}")
    tag = (LEGACY_IDENTITY_TAG if value < REPEAT_ROLL_EFFECTIVE_DATE else
           FIX6_IDENTITY_TAG if value < PROFIT_OPEN_EFFECTIVE_DATE else
           IDENTITY_TAG if value < ORDINARY_PUT_OPEN_EFFECTIVE_DATE else
           FIX9_IDENTITY_TAG if value < FEAR_GRID_EFFECTIVE_DATE else
           FIX10_IDENTITY_TAG if value < IC_CSI500_EFFECTIVE_DATE else FIX11_IDENTITY_TAG)
    return (
        f"ic-im-v1-4-{REVISION}-{tag}-{mode}-digest-delivered-"
        f"{value.isoformat()}-"
    )


def marker_exists(payload: dict[str, object], prefix: str) -> bool:
    artifacts = payload.get("artifacts", [])
    return isinstance(artifacts, list) and any(
        isinstance(item, dict)
        and str(item.get("name", "")).startswith(prefix)
        and not str(item.get("name", "")).endswith("-send-intent")
        and item.get("expired") is not True
        for item in artifacts
    )


def pending_send_exists(payload: dict[str, object], prefix: str) -> bool:
    return any(isinstance(item, dict) and str(item.get("name", "")).startswith(prefix)
               and str(item.get("name", "")).endswith("-send-intent")
               and item.get("expired") is not True for item in payload.get("artifacts", []))


def fetch_artifacts(repository: str, token: str, api_url: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    artifacts: list[object] = []
    for page in range(1, 101):
        payload = fetch_artifact_page(repository, token, api_url, page)
        items = payload.get("artifacts")
        if not isinstance(items, list):
            raise RuntimeError("GitHub artifacts response must contain an artifacts list")
        artifacts.extend(items)
        if len(items) < 100:
            return {"artifacts": artifacts}
    raise RuntimeError("GitHub artifacts pagination exceeded safety limit; refusing uncertain dedupe")


def fetch_artifact_page(repository: str, token: str, api_url: str, page: int) -> dict[str, object]:
    url = f"{api_url.rstrip('/')}/repos/{repository}/actions/artifacts?per_page=100"
    url += f"&page={page}"
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        headers={
            "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
            "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
            "User-Agent": "ic-im-delivery-gate",
        },
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
        payload = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise RuntimeError("GitHub artifacts response must be an object")
    return payload


def write_outputs(values: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    rendered = "".join(f"{key}={value}\n" for key, value in values.items())
    output_path = os.environ.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT", "").strip()
    if output_path:
        with Path(output_path).open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(rendered)
    else:
        print(rendered, end="")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--correction", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--publication-mode",
        choices=("realtime", "close_confirmed"),
        default="realtime",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--repository", default=os.environ.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY", ""))
    parser.add_argument("--token", default=os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN", ""))
    parser.add_argument("--api-url", default=os.environ.get("GITHUB_API_URL", "https://api.github.com"))
    args = parser.parse_args()

    day = delivery_date(now_utc())
    prefix = marker_prefix(day, args.publication_mode)
    exists = False
    if not args.correction:
        if not args.repository or not args.token:
            raise SystemExit("GITHUB_REPOSITORY and GITHUB_TOKEN are required")
        artifacts = fetch_artifacts(args.repository, args.token, args.api_url)
        exists = marker_exists(artifacts, prefix)
        if not exists and pending_send_exists(artifacts, prefix):
            raise RuntimeError("BLOCKED: prior SMTP send intent has no completion marker; delivery is uncertain, reconcile Gmail before explicit correction")
    write_outputs(
        {
            "should_send": str(args.correction or not exists).lower(),
            "marker_prefix": prefix,
            "subject_prefix": "纠正版" if args.correction else "",
        }
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Verify the production SMTP route without submitting a message body."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import smtplib
import ssl
from email.utils import getaddresses
from pathlib import Path


def probe() -> dict:
    required = ("MAIL_SERVER", "MAIL_PORT", "MAIL_USERNAME", "MAIL_PASSWORD", "MAIL_FROM", "MAIL_TO")
    missing = [name for name in required if not os.environ.get(name)]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError("Missing required mail secrets: " + ", ".join(missing))
    port = int(os.environ["MAIL_PORT"])
    sender = [address for _, address in getaddresses([os.environ["MAIL_FROM"]])]
    recipients = [address for _, address in getaddresses([os.environ["MAIL_TO"]])]
    if len(sender) != 1 or not recipients or any("@" not in address for address in sender + recipients):
        raise ValueError("Invalid sender or recipient configuration")
    use_ssl = os.environ.get("MAIL_USE_SSL", "").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes"} or port == 465
    context = ssl.create_default_context()
    if use_ssl:
        client = smtplib.SMTP_SSL(os.environ["MAIL_SERVER"], port, context=context, timeout=30)
    else:
        client = smtplib.SMTP(os.environ["MAIL_SERVER"], port, timeout=30)
    with client as smtp:
        smtp.ehlo()
        if not use_ssl:
            smtp.starttls(context=context)
            smtp.ehlo()
        smtp.login(os.environ["MAIL_USERNAME"], os.environ["MAIL_PASSWORD"])
        code, _ = smtp.mail(sender[0])
        if code != 250:
            raise RuntimeError("SMTP rejected sender envelope")
        try:
            for recipient in recipients:
                code, _ = smtp.rcpt(recipient)
                if code not in {250, 251}:
                    raise RuntimeError("SMTP rejected recipient envelope")
        finally:
            code, _ = smtp.rset()
            if code != 250:
                raise RuntimeError("SMTP did not confirm envelope reset")
    return {"status": "ok", "tls_verified": True, "authenticated": True,
            "sender_envelope_accepted": True, "recipients_accepted": len(recipients),
            "envelope_reset": True, "message_sent": False}


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        result = probe()
    except Exception as exc:
        result = {"status": "failed", "exception_type": type(exc).__name__,
                  "smtp_code": getattr(exc, "smtp_code", None), "message_sent": False}
    path = Path(args.output)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result))
    return 0 if result["status"] == "ok" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Export a bounded, verified research-only handoff; no network or SMTP."""
import argparse
from datetime import date, timedelta
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import zipfile


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--strategy-root', required=True)
    p.add_argument('--strategy-sha', required=True)
    p.add_argument('--source-artifact', required=True, type=int)
    p.add_argument('--state-dir', required=True)
    p.add_argument('--artifact-dir', required=True)
    args = p.parse_args()
    sys.path.insert(0, args.strategy_root)
    import poe_ic_im_mainline_v1_4_bot as bot
    import poe_ic_im_v1_4_state as state
    directory, artifacts = Path(args.state_dir), Path(args.artifact_dir)
    store = state.StateStore(directory)
    latest = store.load_latest()
    preflight = json.loads((artifacts/'preflight.json').read_text())
    result = json.loads((artifacts/'result.json').read_text())
    assert result['status'] in {'ok', 'partial'} and args.source_artifact > 0
    if result['status'] == 'partial':
        assert result.get('signal_completeness') == 'partial' and result.get('incomplete_components')
        from build_ic_im_v1_4_digest import validate_success_payload
        validate_success_payload(result)
    assert preflight['strategy_sha'] == args.strategy_sha
    assert latest['digest'] == preflight['restored_digest'], 'handoff must preserve the restored production ledger'
    assert latest['verified_day'] == preflight['completed_day']
    assert (result['digest'], result['sequence'], result['verified_day']) == (
        latest['digest'], latest['sequence'], latest['verified_day'])
    assert result['market_date'] == preflight['expected_market_day']
    expected_mode = 'realtime' if preflight['publication_mode'] == 'realtime' else 'close_confirmed'
    assert result['publication_mode'] == expected_mode
    report_name = 'ic_im_v1_4_realtime_signal.md' if expected_mode == 'realtime' else 'ic_im_v1_4_close_signal.md'
    assert result['report_file'] == report_name
    assert (artifacts/report_name).resolve().parent == artifacts.resolve()
    previous = None
    journal_paths = []
    for seq in range(latest['sequence']+1):
        item = store.load_sequence(seq)
        state.anchors_from_record(item)
        assert item['sequence'] == seq
        if previous is not None:
            assert item['previous_digest'] == previous['digest']
            assert date.fromisoformat(item['verified_day']) == bot._roll_forward_exchange_day(
                date.fromisoformat(previous['verified_day']) + timedelta(days=1))
        previous = item
        journal_paths.append(directory/'journal'/f"{seq:06d}-{item['verified_day']}.json")
    assert previous['digest'] == latest['digest']
    assert set((directory/'journal').glob('*.json')) == set(journal_paths)
    migration = json.loads((directory/'migration_record.json').read_text())
    assert migration['new_ledger']['digest'] == store.load_sequence(0)['digest']
    # Only normalized research state and reports. Never include transport
    # envelopes, credentials, environment, account data or arbitrary files.
    files = [(f'ledger/{p.relative_to(directory).as_posix()}', p)
             for p in [directory/'latest.json', directory/'migration_record.json', *journal_paths]]
    files += [(f'report/{name}', artifacts/name) for name in ('result.json', report_name, 'preflight.json')]
    manifest = dict(signal_completeness=result.get('signal_completeness', 'complete'), status=result['status'], strategy_sha=args.strategy_sha, source_artifact_id=args.source_artifact,
                    verified_day=latest['verified_day'], sequence=latest['sequence'], digest=latest['digest'],
                    publication_mode=result['publication_mode'], market_date=result['market_date'],
                    files={name:hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name,path in files})
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for name, path in files:
            assert path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size < 4_000_000
            z.writestr(name, path.read_bytes())
        z.writestr('handoff_manifest.json', json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    payload = buffer.getvalue()
    assert len(payload) <= 2_000_000
    # GitHub masks short configured secret values even inside unrelated
    # base64 research data. A-P avoids boolean words and numeric SMTP ports.
    encoded = payload.hex().translate(str.maketrans("0123456789abcdef", "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP"))
    metadata = json.dumps(dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(), bytes=len(payload),
                               encoding='nibble-ap'), sort_keys=True).encode()
    print('ICIM_HANDOFF_META_AP='+metadata.hex().translate(str.maketrans("0123456789abcdef", "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP")))
    print('ICIM_HANDOFF_SHA256='+hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest())
    print('ICIM_HANDOFF_ENCODING=nibble-ap')
    for i in range(0,len(encoded),6000):
        print('ICIM_HANDOFF_CHUNK='+encoded[i:i+6000])
    print('ICIM_HANDOFF_END='+str(len(payload)))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path


EXPECTED_REVISION = "r7"


def marker_name(payload: dict[str, object]) -> str:
    if payload.get("status") != "ok":
        raise ValueError("delivery marker requires a successful signal result")
    if str(payload.get("strategy_revision")) != EXPECTED_REVISION:
        raise ValueError("delivery marker requires strategy_revision=r7")
    publication_mode = str(payload.get("publication_mode", ""))
    if publication_mode not in {"realtime", "close_confirmed"}:
        raise ValueError("delivery marker has unsupported publication_mode")
    market_date = str(payload.get("market_date", ""))
    digest = str(payload.get("digest", ""))
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", market_date) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", digest):
        raise ValueError("delivery marker requires market_date and full SHA-256 digest")
    date.fromisoformat(market_date)
    return (
        f"ic-im-v1-3-{EXPECTED_REVISION}-{publication_mode}-digest-delivered-"
        f"{market_date}-{digest[:12]}"
    )


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--result", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--marker-dir", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    payload = json.loads(Path(args.result).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    name = marker_name(payload)
    marker_dir = Path(args.marker_dir)
    marker_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (marker_dir / "delivery.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "strategy_revision": payload["strategy_revision"],
                "publication_mode": payload["publication_mode"],
                "market_date": payload["market_date"],
                "digest": payload["digest"],
                "github_run_url": os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_URL", ""),
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    output_path = os.environ.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT", "").strip()
    rendered = f"marker_name={name}\n"
    if output_path:
        with Path(output_path).open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(rendered)
    else:
        print(rendered, end="")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from check_ic_im_v1_4_delivery import (
    REVISION as EXPECTED_REVISION,
    expected_identity_for_day,
    marker_prefix,
)


def marker_name(payload: dict[str, object]) -> str:
    from ic_im_v1_4_delivery_contract import validate_fear_publication
    validate_fear_publication(payload)
    if payload.get("status") not in {"ok", "partial"}:
        raise ValueError("delivery marker requires a successful signal result")
    if payload.get("status") == "partial" and (
        payload.get("signal_completeness") != "partial" or not payload.get("incomplete_components")
        or not any(s.get("grid_action") == "UNCONFIRMED" and s.get("fear_source_policy_revision") == "baifenwei_either_source_20261016_v1"
                   for s in payload.get("signals", {}).values())):
        raise ValueError("partial delivery requires explicit bounded Fear warning")
    if str(payload.get("strategy_revision")) != EXPECTED_REVISION:
        raise ValueError("delivery marker requires strategy_revision=r1")
    market_date = str(payload.get("market_date", ""))
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", market_date):
        raise ValueError("delivery marker requires ISO market_date")
    parsed_market_date = date.fromisoformat(market_date)
    expected_build, expected_delivery = expected_identity_for_day(parsed_market_date)
    if str(payload.get("build")) != expected_build:
        raise ValueError("delivery marker build does not match signal-day identity")
    if str(payload.get("delivery_revision", "")) != expected_delivery:
        raise ValueError("delivery marker revision does not match signal-day identity")
    publication_mode = str(payload.get("publication_mode", ""))
    if publication_mode not in {"realtime", "close_confirmed"}:
        raise ValueError("delivery marker has unsupported publication_mode")
    digest = str(payload.get("digest", ""))
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", market_date) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", digest):
        raise ValueError("delivery marker requires market_date and full SHA-256 digest")
    return f"{marker_prefix(parsed_market_date, publication_mode)}{digest[:12]}"


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--result", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--marker-dir", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    payload = json.loads(Path(args.result).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    # The naming helper is also used inside this validator.  Keep the import
    # at the write boundary so standalone CLI use gets the full contract
    # without introducing a module-level circular dependency.
    from build_ic_im_v1_4_digest import validate_success_payload
    validate_success_payload(payload)
    name = marker_name(payload)
    marker_dir = Path(args.marker_dir)
    marker_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (marker_dir / "delivery.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "strategy_revision": payload["strategy_revision"],
                "build": payload["build"],
                "delivery_revision": payload["delivery_revision"],
                "publication_mode": payload["publication_mode"],
                "market_date": payload["market_date"],
                "digest": payload["digest"],
                "signal_completeness": payload.get("signal_completeness", "complete"),
                "github_run_url": os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_URL", ""),
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    output_path = os.environ.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT", "").strip()
    rendered = f"marker_name={name}\n"
    if output_path:
        with Path(output_path).open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(rendered)
    else:
        print(rendered, end="")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Real saved monthly maintenance result plus clearly marked synthetic guards."""
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts'))
import build_ic_im_v1_4_digest as digest
import ic_im_v1_4_put_display as display

FIXTURES = Path(__file__).parent / 'fixtures/icim'


def real_result():
    return json.loads((FIXTURES/'maintenance_20261016/result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))


def test_real_provenance_and_candidate_identity():
    source = FIXTURES/'maintenance_20261016/result.json'
    provenance = json.loads((source.parent/'provenance.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert provenance['run_id'] == '38853603565'
    assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == provenance['sha256']
    signal = real_result()['signals']['IC']
    assert signal['v14_core_put_contract'] == '510500P2612M07500'
    assert signal['put_target_contract'] == '510500P2612M06500'
    assert display.ic_contract(signal, 'current', 'core') == '510500P2612M07500'
    assert display.ic_contract(signal, 'target', 'core') == '510500P2612M06500'
    assert '17张' in digest.put_text('IC', signal, True)
    assert '510500P2612M07500' not in digest.put_text('IC', signal, True)


def test_real_builder_plain_html_separate_futures_and_today_put_without_mutation():
    item = real_result()
    before = deepcopy(item)
    subject, plain, _ = digest.build_success(item, '', '')
    html = digest.build_success_html(item, '')
    assert '月度Put需维护' in subject
    for text in (plain, html):
        assert text.count('今日（2026-10-16）') == 2
        assert text.count('2026-10-16 当天收盘完成换仓') == 2
